g.aria-label: Input-Dependent Affine Recurrence: Parallel Projection + Scan
Selective Clock Gating via Input-Driven Survival Factor a_t ∈ (0, 1)^d
• Informative token x_t → a_t,i ≈ 0: flushes stale coordinate i and writes fresh candidate b_t,i
• Uninformative filler x_t → a_t,i ≈ 1: freezes coordinate i (h_t,i ≈ h_t-1,i) with zero decay
